title: I Followed the Paintball Chrono Tag Into the Chrono They Skipped

parts.text: I chronoed at 11:08 a.m. and got a green tag. The walk-on next to me walked on with no tag. The field rule the ref posted said: NO TAG, NO FIELD. STAFF FRIENDS INCLUDED. I was twenty-three, rental marker, holding a 280 fps slip. Ref friends called it a house gun. I photographed the untagged hopper, the rule, and my tag. Then I followed them to the chrono they had skipped and asked the head ref to pull the still. At 11:13 the head ref asked why a house gun was on a skipped-chrono ticket.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: The head ref can see an untagged hopper on the field against the no-tag rule.

social.video_title: The house gun skipped the paintball chrono — Part 1/2
social.description: Green tag, a walk-on with none, and a field rule. I followed them to chrono. Would you have played anyway?

parts.text: They called it a warm barrel until chrono read 340. I printed the ticket, the rule, and the photo. They turned down. I kept my green. They told the staging area the rule was always about optics. Optics is a word refs use when 340 is on a slip. Chrono policy now has a second line: HOUSE GUNS TAG. I play. They twist velocity. The net finally has only green.

social.video_title: House guns still take a tag — Part 2/2
social.description: Skipped-chrono ticket, 340 turned down, and a second line on the rule. Was a warm barrel ever 60 fps extra?
